name: @goblinmuse/mcp

tools.name: auth
tools.description: Whoami: the identity your GOBLINMUSE_TOKEN resolves to (userId, email, credit balance, tier). Call first to confirm the token + balance before spending.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Discover what you can generate. Returns each capability with its slug, modality, kind, input_schema, and per-variant credit cost. Read input_schema here instead of hardcoding params.

tools.name: aigc
tools.description: Generate an image or video. image: waits inline for the result (falls back to a taskId if slow) and downloads it locally. video: returns a taskId to poll with status(). Params come from capabilities().input_schema. Retrying the same request never double-charges.

imageRef.description: source image reference for image-to-* operations

nsfw.description: request an NSFW-tier capability (relayed to the server)

store.description: keep the job in list() history (default true)

idempotencyKey.description: override the auto-derived idempotency key (rarely needed)

tools.name: status
tools.description: Poll a job to completion. COMPLETED → assets download locally (paths in the result) + presigned URLs. BLOCKED → content policy (0% refund). FAILED → technical (auto-refunded). QUEUED/RUNNING → poll again after retry_after_ms.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List your stored jobs (store=true only), newest first.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Cancel a job by taskId. Still-reserved variants are canceled (refunded by the sweeper); already-running ones finish.
